# SwitchSize

`Flare.Components.SwitchSize`

Size of FlareSwitch on the shared Xs..Xl scale; medium is the default. The steps are labels, not measurements - each theme maps them onto its own track and thumb tokens, and they differ: one theme's medium switch is not another's.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small (compact) switch. |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium - the default. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large. |

## Used by components

- `FlareSwitch`
